name: tridentchain-security
description: Comprehensive local supply-chain CVE scanning — project deps, system packages (Homebrew/apt), AND IDE extensions (VS Code, JetBrains) — with EPSS exploit-probability and CISA KEV prioritisation. Includes validate-after-patch workflow to confirm fixes. Local-first; no source code leaves the user's machine. Complements project-only CI scanners by covering surfaces they miss.
